name: Petra
source:
A high energy girl who partakes in the science camp's physics class. She has a reputation of wracking havoc in the lab with her unstoppable impulsiveness. Her curiosity is without borders, as is her intelligence....as long as it comes to physics. In other subjects, she has some serious weaknesses. 

She's very good friends with [url=/c131953]Marie[/url], and is highly protective of her.
